common.description: Rent aircraft from verified owners across Europe. Pilots, owners, technicians and airports in one place.

footer.tagline: Made for general aviation in Europe.

home.title: Rent a plane. Fly more.
home.subtitle: Find verified aircraft to rent near you and book with owners who can see your ratings. Hiring technicians and requesting airport services will follow, all in one place.

pilots.title: Pilots
pilots.text: Search aircraft near you by dates, see specs, price per hour and availability, and send a booking request.

owners.title: Owners
owners.text: List your aircraft, manage its calendar and decide who flies it with a minimum pilot rating and experience rules.

technicians.title: Technicians
technicians.text: Offer 50 h and 100 h checks and other maintenance to owners nearby.

airports.title: Airports
airports.text: Take PPR, apron parking, hangar, fuel and customs requests online.

home.trustEasa: Built for EASA rules and European airfields
home.accountDeleted: Your account and all its data have been deleted.

search.title: Find aircraft
search.text: Search aircraft by airport, dates and specs.

ownerAircraft.title: List your aircraft
ownerAircraft.text: List your aircraft, set prices and choose who can rent it.
